subject.title: feat(nodes): continue Claude catalog sessions on paired nodes via streaming CLI agent runs

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support approval-gated Claude CLI continuation on paired headless nodes with this new config and protocol contract, and should the core-only process-resolution helper also become public Plugin SDK API?
rationale: The implementation establishes long-lived remote-execution, configuration, wire-protocol, session-placement, and third-party API contracts; code review can verify mechanics but cannot choose those permanent product boundaries.

options.title: Sponsor a narrowed v1
options.body: Approve the paired-node feature and additive protocol, keep the process helper internal, fix terminal-result handling, and require live proof before merge.

options.title: Sponsor all proposed surfaces
options.body: Accept the config, protocol, session fields, and public Plugin SDK export as permanent contracts after the defect and proof gate are resolved.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Keep the linked issue and this PR open or close them later if maintainers do not want core to own remote vendor-CLI agent execution.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrowed v1
recommendation.body: Approve the paired-node feature and additive protocol, keep the process helper internal, fix terminal-result handling, and require live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He originated the linked feature direction and has the strongest demonstrated ownership across the affected Claude CLI, node, and session-runtime surfaces.
